name: @devdigest/agent-runner
description: DevDigest CI runner — the I/O wrapper that runs the reviewer-core engine inside someone else's repository. Travels as ONE committed file (dist/runner.mjs), exported to .devdigest/runner.mjs and invoked by the generated workflow as `node .devdigest/runner.mjs review --agent <slug>`. Reads the PR diff from the GitHub API, runs the shared engine, posts the review, writes devdigest-result.json, and exits non-zero exactly when the manifest's ci_fail_on gate trips.
